spec.alternate_boot_path: TWRP boot-image replacement, as used by the supplied z3q reference
spec.evidence: LineageOS install guide for a52sxq writes every image through Download mode with samloader (Odin protocol); no fastboot step exists. HakiOS starts from `fastboot boot`, which this bootloader does not speak. The supplied z3q reference's TWRP route writes /dev/block/by-name/boot with adb shell dd; see https://github.com/ch1tmdgus/hackios-z3q/blob/main/xl.
spec.notes: Same SoC as the HakiOS redwood reference port, so the SoC layer is reusable; the phone layer (panel, touch, PMIC rails, UEFI) is not. The z3q TWRP method requires a persistent boot-partition write and is therefore blocked by this port's storage policy.

notes: a52sxq uses the samsung-download bootloader: read-only device probing was skipped; the alternative path (TWRP boot-image replacement, as used by the supplied z3q reference) writes persistent storage and is blocked

capability.reason: Samsung Galaxy A52s 5G (a52sxq) has no fastboot protocol: its bootloader is samsung-download. `fastboot boot` cannot be used, and this tool will not substitute flashing or Odin. The known alternative path (TWRP boot-image replacement, as used by the supplied z3q reference) writes the persistent boot partition and is blocked by policy.

detail:
LineageOS install guide for a52sxq writes every image through Download mode with samloader (Odin protocol); no fastboot step exists. HakiOS starts from `fastboot boot`, which this bootloader does not speak. The supplied z3q reference's TWRP route writes /dev/block/by-name/boot with adb shell dd; see https://github.com/ch1tmdgus/hackios-z3q/blob/main/xl.

This tool will not substitute flashing or Odin. The alternate route (TWRP boot-image replacement, as used by the supplied z3q reference) writes persistent storage and is forbidden.
